name: app-pastel-gradient-onboarding-cards-with-app-icon-keys-and-lists
title: Gradient onboarding cards for a to-do app: app icon, keyboard shortcut keys, list preview and check tile, with blue Continue pills
whatItIs: A grey board with rounded white cards each topped by a soft gradient (sky blue to lilac, mint, pink) holding a hero object: a glossy blue-ring app icon on white, two keycaps 'command' and 'D', a sidebar list of Home, Today, Friends and Work with counts, and a check tile; below each a heading, a grey description, a blue Continue pill and page dots.
whatItMeans: Light and delightful; gradient tops make each feature a small gift.
techniques: Give each card a different soft gradient top.
Put one hero object per card.
Use a single blue Continue pill.

vocabulary.definition: A soft gradient area above the text of a card.
A keyboard key drawn as an object.
The main icon on a card.
